answer: Sybil resistance relies on collateral bonded in escrow for each identity: if k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated claims, pairwise evidence exposes up to k(k−1)/2 links, making aggregate penalties scale as O(k²), rather than as independent linear fines. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds the swarm’s capital loss by an exponential multiplier, regardless of whether its identities are organized as ridge, zephyr, or grove.
